title: Professional Email Included Applications and Compliance Features
content:
What each Professional Email product includes beyond mail, as the plan specification lists it.

| Product | Desktop Office apps | Microsoft Teams | Defender for Business and Intune device management | Litigation hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | No | No | No | No |
| Harborline Mail Plus | No | No | No | No |
| Harborline Mail Pro | No | No | No | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | No | Yes | No | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading across the table

- Microsoft Teams is included in all three Microsoft 365 Business products and in no Harborline Mail product.
- Desktop Office apps begin at Microsoft 365 Business Standard.
- Defender for Business, Intune device management and litigation hold are included only in Microsoft 365 Business Premium.
- Example (hypothetical): a customer who needs litigation hold for mailboxes is looking at Microsoft 365 Business Premium, the only product marked Yes in that column.
